tracks.name: NFL
tracks.research_focus: Quarterback-adjusted team strength, EPA-based matchups, calibrated win probabilities, point margins and game totals.
model_sequence: usage-conditioned player props after the game-level audit
tracks.temporal_boundary: Realized starters, observed game weather and final statistics are labels or postgame records unless a separate pre-decision source establishes availability.

tracks.name: NBA
tracks.research_focus: Player-minute and usage distributions, rotation-aware game forecasts, pace, spreads and totals.
tracks.temporal_boundary: Final starting lineups, actual minutes and late injury updates must not enter a forecast produced before they were available. Player props require a separate event-market backfill.

tracks.name: NCAA football
tracks.research_focus: Opponent-adjusted play efficiency, quarterback and roster transitions, recruiting and schedule-aware margin forecasts.
model_sequence: hierarchical team offense and defense ratings
feature_families: recruiting and transfers with publication dates
tracks.temporal_boundary: End-of-season ratings, revised recruiting assessments and current rosters cannot stand in for the values available in a historical forecast week.

tracks.name: NCAA men's basketball
tracks.research_focus: Possession efficiency, tempo, player availability and calibrated game-margin distributions across regular-season and tournament play.
model_sequence: tournament simulations driven by game-level distributions
tracks.temporal_boundary: CollegeBasketballData season labels use ending years. Post-tournament ratings and retrospectively corrected injury data require explicit vintage checks. Existing March Madness research remains a separate project.

tracks.name: NCAA women's basketball
tracks.research_focus: Player-adjusted team strength, possession efficiency, tempo and roster continuity with explicit separation between long statistical history and shorter odds history.
tracks.temporal_boundary: Market evaluation begins only where timestamped quotes are actually present; the planned provider starting date is November 12, 2024. Older statistics do not create older market quotes.
